reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and takes the tolerance from the existing getApproxNumberThreshold used by rule matching, rather than re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside the shared helper; call sites only pass their operator.

placement.why: Rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the module every server and client consumer already imports it from.

scope.why: Helper, its tests, and threading the operator through the existing call sites; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Single definition is easy to own; the operator is an optional positional parameter inserted before `inverse`, so a caller that forgets it silently gets exact-value planning.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, called with the operator by forecast, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), schedule-template, preview, API schedules-get and the desktop/mobile schedule views and balance
